description: Search the EuroVoc thesaurus, resolving a keyword into concept URIs usable in the eurovoc_concept subject filter of eurlex_search_documents. Matches both preferred and alternative (non-preferred) labels, so a common synonym reaches the concept it stands for. Returns each concept URI, its preferred label in the requested language, code, broader (parent) label, and the alternative label that matched when one did. Concepts with an exact label match come first, then those whose label or one of its words starts with the keyword, then other substring matches, each group ordered by preferred label.

keyword.description: Search term matched against EuroVoc preferred and alternative concept labels (e.g. "privacy", "agriculture", "product liability").

language.description: Language code for concept labels (e.g. "en", "fr", "de"). Case-insensitive — "EN" and "en" behave identically. Defaults to English.

limit.description: Maximum number of EuroVoc concepts to return, served up to 50 per call; a larger value (up to 10,000) is served at 50 and reported in limit_clamp. Defaults to 20.

offset.description: Pagination offset — number of concepts to skip. Defaults to 0. Must be below 10,000: CELLAR sorts at most 10,000 matches for one search, so pages stop at row 10,000.

name: eurlex_browse_subjects

cap.description: The limit that was applied to this response.

concepts.description: Matching EuroVoc concepts, exact label matches first, then word-start matches, then other substring matches, each group ordered by preferred label.

items.description: A single EuroVoc concept with its URI, label, code, and hierarchy context.

broader_label.description: Preferred label of the broader (parent) concept, if available.

concept_uri.description: Full URI for the EuroVoc concept, usable in the eurovoc_concept filter.

matched_label.description: Alternative (non-preferred) EuroVoc label that matched the keyword, when one did — the closest match (exact, then word start, then substring), alphabetical among equals. Absent when the keyword matched the preferred label alone.

pref_label.description: Preferred label for the concept in the requested language.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `offset_past_window`: offset is 10,000 or more, past the last row CELLAR sorts for one search. `sparql_error`: CELLAR rejected the thesaurus search this call sent. The same call fails the same way again. `sparql_timeout`: The thesaurus search ran past the client timeout, or CELLAR refused it as too costly to run. It is not retried. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: True only when CELLAR returned an additional valid row beyond this page. False on a page that ends at row 10,000, the last one CELLAR sorts; its notice says whether more may match.

limit_clamp.description: Present only when limit exceeded the per-call maximum: the value asked for and the value served. The response follows the applied value.

applied.description: The limit served: the per-call maximum.

requested.description: The limit the call asked for.

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page. Present only when has_more is true.

notice.description: Guidance for the next call: on an empty first page, the keyword and language that matched nothing and how to broaden them; on a page with more rows, the offset to continue from; on a page ending at row 10,000, that no later page can be read and how to narrow the keyword.

offset.description: Pagination offset used for this response.

shown.description: Number of concepts returned in this response.

total.description: Number of concepts returned in this response.

truncated.description: True when an additional CELLAR row proves more concepts exist beyond this page.

title: Browse EuroVoc Subjects
